minutes.summary: The committee held a short meeting, ending at 6:01 PM because members had to leave, and reviewed the simplified space-needs analysis department by department. what_happened.line: The Municipal Building Design Committee reviewed a simplified space-needs analysis for the Ritter annex, department by department, and took no votes except adjournment.
The running town-side total for the annex exceeded the stated square-footage goal, with bathrooms and break rooms still to be added.
Open items include the conservation, Historical Commission, ZBA and select board offices, and the committee leaned toward keeping a veterans office.
The chair and one member were assigned a tape-measure survey of offices to verify file-storage needs, and another member is to clarify school-side questions.
The meeting adjourned by vote at 6:01 PM because members had to leave.

why_it_matters: The space-needs table sets how much room the town plans for in the Ritter annex, which drives the size and cost of a project residents may later be asked to fund.
The analysis is meant to go to an architect once one is under agreement, so the figures settled now will shape the design work.
watch_next: The revised space-needs table, which the chair is to email before the next meeting, and the storage re-measurement results.
Whether an architect is placed under agreement, at which point the analysis is to be handed over.
